## IPublishSarifReviewOptions.suggestionLabel property

The existing label every suggestion pull request carries (default`suggestion`<!-- -->). Allowed only with `suggestionPullRequests: true`<!-- -->. It is never created: a missing label blocks the review.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly suggestionLabel?: string | undefined;
```
